; the impact itself: a plate struck under water-loaded damping gives a short dull knock
; under the whistle, and without it the crack has no beginning
anz     rand 1.0, 0.5, 1
akn     interp kev * kev
ank     reson anz * akn, limit(kf0 * 2.2, 20, 15000), kf0 * 1.6, 2
amix    = ach1 + ach2 + ank * 0.55
; The energy per second is already independent of the rate -- the envelope is written
; against PHASE, so each event's duration and energy both scale as 1/rate -- but the
; chirp's own bandwidth is not, and `balance` is what holds the two axes to one loudness
; across the whole cube and the keyboard. Safe here because this body STANDS: it is a
; continuous train of arrivals, not a decay a follower could flatten.
aref    poscil 0.3000, 400
asig    balance amix, aref, 1
anchor_code.glide=across the lake:
kcrack  = 0.45                              ; crack [0..1]: how busy the ice is
kglide  = 1                              ; glide [0..1]: how far each crack falls
kf0     = (kfreq * koct1)
; A crack in lake ice does not reach you as a click. Flexural waves in a plate are
; DISPERSIVE -- their phase velocity goes as the square root of frequency -- so the high
; components of one impulse outrun the low ones and arrive first. What you hear is a
; descending chirp, and its shape is fixed by that dispersion and not chosen: arrival time
; t(f) = d / (k * sqrt(f)) inverts to f(t) proportional to 1/t^2. That falling whistle is
; the entire sound of singing ice, and nothing else in this library makes one.
; A whole sheet of ice is not one crack: a lake under a cold night cracks continuously,
; from everywhere at once, each arrival its own chirp. So the rate runs from 4 to 48 a
; second and not from one -- at a rate low enough to count the cracks the level of a note
; depends on which cracks happened to land in it, which is a window artefact and not a
; sound, and the whole cube read 2.46 dB apart with a corner travelling 66 dB inside one
; note. Two trains at incommensurate rates, because one is a machine.
krt     = 4.0 + 44.0 * kcrack                ; arrivals a second
; Seed inside the 0..1 range, and 31-bit like every other source here: at `, 2` it
; was out of range, so this body seeded from the CLOCK and never rendered twice the
; same -- see `bubbles` for what that cost the measurements.
kjit    randi 0.30, 0.7, 0.5, 1              ; ice cracks irregularly
kph     phasor krt * (1 + kjit)
kph2    phasor krt * 0.617 * (1 - kjit * 0.6)
; How far off the cracks are is what moves: the sheet answers from nearer and further as
; you listen, and a longer path means a steeper dive. This is the coherent motion in the
; body -- a chirp train alone reads as variance, because a jittered sweep has a broadband
; centroid track and the meter asks for a rate it can find.
kdst    poscil 0.5, 0.19
kdp     = (2 + 34 * kglide) * (0.45 + 1.10 * (0.5 + kdst))
; The chirp. `kglide` is how far above the note it starts, and the 1/(1+B*t)^2 shape is
; the dispersion law above, not a taste.
kdv     = 1 + kdp / (1 + 46 * kph) ^ 2
kdv2    = 1 + kdp * 0.63 / (1 + 61 * kph2) ^ 2
; A dispersive arrival BUILDS -- it is a wave train reaching you, not a contact. Written
; against PHASE like the decay, so the rise is a fixed fraction of the gap between
; cracks and the energy per second still does not depend on the rate. It is here because
; an instantaneous attack made this body CLIP: over 125 renders of the cube at five
; registers the true peak reached 4.04 against the host's 2.97, while p99.9 -- what the
; gate then checked -- read 1.98, because four cracks a second occupy well under 0.1 %
; of the buffer. At a rise of 1/45 of the period the worst peak over the same sweep is
; 2.50, and 2.54 over 120 renders concentrated on the corner that produced it, while the
; crest stays 21.6 dB at the sparse end against 22.6 before: still plainly cracks.
kev     = exp(-9 * kph) * (1 - exp(-45 * kph))    ; near zero before it wraps: no click
; MOVEMENT: TEXTURE
; A stochastic event texture, not a sustained tone.
; Its liveness is where and when the events fall, which no statistic in
; `lco_measure` can tell from a static noise bed (see `declares_texture`).
kev2    = exp(-13 * kph2) * (1 - exp(-45 * kph2))
ach1    poscil kev * 0.30, limit(kf0 * kdv, 20, 18000)
ach2    poscil kev2 * 0.17, limit(kf0 * kdv2, 20, 18000)
; the impact itself: a plate struck under water-loaded damping gives a short dull knock
; under the whistle, and without it the crack has no beginning
anz     rand 1.0, 0.5, 1
akn     interp kev * kev
ank     reson anz * akn, limit(kf0 * 2.2, 20, 15000), kf0 * 1.6, 2
amix    = ach1 + ach2 + ank * 0.55
; The energy per second is already independent of the rate -- the envelope is written
; against PHASE, so each event's duration and energy both scale as 1/rate -- but the
; chirp's own bandwidth is not, and `balance` is what holds the two axes to one loudness
; across the whole cube and the keyboard. Safe here because this body STANDS: it is a
; continuous train of arrivals, not a decay a follower could flatten.
aref    poscil 0.3000, 400
asig    balance amix, aref, 1

acln0   = aao0s0u0 * 1.000000    ; clean oscillator (pre-drive)
adrv0   = acln0                     ; drive 0: clean, no saturator stage
kagw0   oscili 0.024, 0.7        ; age: amplitude wobble
asig    = adrv0 * (1 + kagw0)

adjectives.why: washed out, faded, distant — the highs rolled well back and a faint sheen left over them, so nothing in the sound has a hard edge any more
adjectives.code:
aprea    = asig                       ; exciter source, pre-tilt
asig     tone asig, 2800            ; dark tilt (low-pass)
aexc     atone aprea, 3500             ; the band that carries air
aexc     = tanh(aexc * 3.0) * 0.5      ; breed partials ABOVE it
asig     = asig + aexc * 0.12       ; air / sheen (no noise)

motions.why: dark to bright, ONCE: the spectrum opens over the note and stays open. A one-way gesture — it never travels back. Stands on its own (a filter opening) and is also the opening half of the larger movements.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice starts its movement
                                        ; elsewhere -- a chord must not move in lockstep
kpos    = min(knote / 2.5, 1)           ; one-way ramp, holds at the top
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: bright to dark, ONCE: the spectrum closes over the note and stays closed. The mirror of open_up, and equally a gesture in its own right — not a phase of a cycle.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice starts its movement
                                        ; elsewhere -- a chord must not move in lockstep
kpos    = 1 - min(knote / 2.5, 1)       ; one-way ramp, holds at the bottom
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: one pass across the spectrum. The SPEED is not fixed — `slow`, `fast` and `snap` set it; on its own it is a single unhurried traversal.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice starts its movement
                                        ; elsewhere -- a chord must not move in lockstep
kpos    = sin(min(knote / 2.0, 1) * 3.14159)  ; one pass out and back, then rests
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: wobbling, warping — around 2.2 Hz but NOT a clean oscillation: the rate itself wavers, which is what makes it a wobble rather than a vibrato.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice starts its movement
                                        ; elsewhere -- a chord must not move in lockstep
kjit    randi  0.7, 3.1, ivoice         ; the RATE wavers -- that is the wobble
kmot    oscili 0.5, 2.2 + kjit, giSine, ivph
kpos    = kmot + 0.5
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: out and back, out and back at a leisurely ~0.25 Hz — mechanically regular, like a ball between two walls.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice starts its movement
                                        ; elsewhere -- a chord must not move in lockstep
kmot    oscili 0.5, 0.25, giSine, ivph  ; regular there-and-back
kpos    = kmot + 0.5
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: a slow there-and-back at about 0.16 Hz. The RATE is steady -- breathing is -- but no two passes are shaped alike: a second rate in an irrational ratio keeps each pass uneven. That unevenness is what separates it from `cycle`.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice starts its movement
                                        ; elsewhere -- a chord must not move in lockstep
kb1     oscili 0.32, 0.16, giSine, ivph ; two rates in an irrational ratio,
kb2     oscili 0.18, 0.259, giSine, ivph ; so no two passes are shaped alike
kpos    = 0.5 + kb1 + kb2
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: the timbre keeps travelling and NEVER comes back to where it was. Not a cycle and not a rate: random steps at two speeds, so no state recurs for the length of any note. It must be moving within the first seconds — a note is short.
motions.code:
ke1     randi  0.30, 0.37, ivoice       ; seeded per voice -- a chord must not move
ke2     randi  0.20, 0.83, ivoice + 7   ; in lockstep. Random steps at two rates:
kpos    = 0.5 + ke1 + ke2               ; no period at all, so no state ever recurs
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: still, steady, held — no movement is added at all; the escape hatch for a tone that must stand perfectly still.
the timbre travels round and back at a steady, clearly audible rate (~1.1 Hz). Genuinely regular — a circling movement you can count.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice starts its movement
                                        ; elsewhere -- a chord must not move in lockstep
kmot    oscili 0.5, 1.1, giSine, ivph   ; regular, returns exactly
kpos    = kmot + 0.5
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: a fast, restless flutter of the whole colour -- faster than a wobble and never even: the rate itself will not settle. Tape flutter, flutter-tonguing.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice moves on its own -- a chord
                                        ; must not move in lockstep
kfj     randi  2.6, 11.0, ivoice        ; the rate itself never settles -- that is flutter
kmot    oscili 0.5, 6.5 + kfj, giSine, ivph
kpos    = kmot + 0.5
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: a regular tremor in the PITCH, about a sixth of a semitone wide -- vibrato. Not a colour movement and not a loudness one: the tone itself wavers, evenly, the way a played note does.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice moves on its own -- a chord
                                        ; must not move in lockstep
kv      oscili 0.3, 5.5, giSine, ivph   ; a regular 5.5 Hz tremor, +-0.3 ms of delay
asig    vdelay asig, 2 + kv, 10         ; a modulated delay IS a pitch tremor

motions.why: a regular pulsation of the LOUDNESS, about 4.5 times a second. This is the one movement that touches level rather than colour, because that is what the word means -- but it PULSES and never fades: the note's own envelope still belongs to the player.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice moves on its own -- a chord
                                        ; must not move in lockstep
ktr     oscili 0.18, 4.5, giSine, ivph  ; +-1.4 dB, a steady pulse -- never a fade
asig    = asig * (1 + ktr)

motions.why: a glinting in the TOP of the spectrum: the high partials catch the light and let it go again, irregularly. Only the top moves -- the body of the tone stands still. This form re-weights partials that are ALREADY there, so it needs a tone with a bright tail; on a mellow FM tone there is nothing above the highpass to glint with.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice moves on its own -- a chord
                                        ; must not move in lockstep
ahi     butterhp asig, 2200             ; the top of the spectrum, on its own
abri    = asig + ahi * 1.2              ; a fixed GLINTING copy of the tone ...
abri    balance abri, asig, 1           ; ... matched to the clean level ONCE
kg      randi  0.5, 9.0, ivoice         ; irregular glints, never a steady beat
kpos    = 0.5 + kg
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + abri * kpos   ; so this can only move COLOUR

alt.when: the tone is FM -- then glint the INDEX, which MAKES and unmakes sidebands instead of re-weighting ones that may not exist
alt.code:
kg      randi  0.45, 9.0, ivoice        ; irregular glints, never a steady beat
asig    foscili 0.5, kfreq * koct1, 1, 2, 3.0 + kg * 3.0, giSine
                                        ; the index itself glints: the
                                        ; sidebands come and go. foscili
                                        ; holds its own level, so nothing
                                        ; has to hold it afterwards.

motions.why: the movement dies away: it stirs at the start and comes to rest, and does not start again. A gesture that decelerates into stillness.
motions.code:
ivph    = frac(ivoice * 0.6180339887)   ; each voice starts its movement
                                        ; elsewhere -- a chord must not move in lockstep
kmot    oscili 0.5, 0.5, giSine, ivph
kpos    = 0.5 + kmot * exp(-knote * 0.35)  ; the movement decays to rest and stays
adrv    = tanh(asig * 4.4)              ; a fixed BRIGHT copy of the same tone
adrv    balance adrv, asig, 1           ; matched to the clean level ONCE ...
asig    = asig * (1 - kpos) + adrv * kpos   ; ... so this can only move COLOUR

motions.why: not a movement of its own: it STRETCHES whatever movement is present — halve its rate, or double the time it takes to traverse.
not a movement of its own: it COMPRESSES whatever movement is present — multiply its rate by 1.7, or divide its traversal time by 1.7.
not a movement of its own: it sharply compresses whatever movement is present — triple its rate, or take a third of its traversal time.
